projects.title: Language-Grounded 3D Gaussian Splatting for Robotic Manipulation
projects.role: Text in, robot target out: CLIP-embedded splats driving a SmolVLA planner on an AR4 arm.
report: Building an end-to-end pipeline from natural-language query to robot action: text → CLIP-embedded 3DGS scene → 3D object localization → XYZ manipulation targets for a SmolVLA motion planner on a physical AR4 arm.

Achieved 29.60 dB PSNR / 0.952 SSIM / 0.078 LPIPS lab-scene reconstruction (621/621 gimbal-captured frames registered at 0.96 px), a +2.1 dB improvement over baseline, trained with gsplat MCMC on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96GB).

Two documented ablations: per-folder COLMAP camera mode for mixed video/still captures (14 dB → 29 dB on identical images), and Gaussian budget vs. training length (1M @ 30K steps outperforms 3M @ 100K).
Diagnosed a catastrophically broken scene scale (~5M units), traced it to sequential matching on unordered captures, and resolved it via exhaustive feature matching.

projects.title: Open-Vocabulary Semantic 3D Queries
projects.role: Ask the scene for an object in plain words, get its 3D position back.
report: Engineered CLIP ViT-B/32 feature distillation into trained Gaussians with a semantic query engine.
Achieved 9/10 correct 3D object localizations on real captures (4/5 open-vocabulary, beyond closed-set detectors).
Built a ROS2 + Gazebo autonomous capture pipeline (304 keyframes) feeding sim-side training data collection.

projects.title: UAV Drone Detection & Multi-Object Tracking
projects.role: Fine-tuned YOLOv8n and an 8-state Kalman tracker for drones in flight.
report: Fine-tuned YOLOv8n on 3,000+ drone images.
Built a custom 8-state Kalman tracker [cx, cy, w, h, vx, vy, vw, vh] with Hungarian-algorithm assignment.
Built a full annotation pipeline overlaying tracks, predictions and trajectory polylines.

projects.title: Sim-to-Real Geometric Alignment
projects.role: Puts the splat in the robot's frame. Caught ICP faking a clean result. Merged.
report: Built and validated a Umeyama similarity-transform engine (sub-mm synthetic accuracy) and a scale-aware robust ICP engine with FPFH+RANSAC global initialization (0.46 mm on synthetic ground truth) for 3DGS-to-robot-frame registration.
Found that unconstrained 7-DOF ICP silently converges to a 28° mis-tilt (5.8 mm RMSE) on quasi-symmetric geometry.
Designed a gravity-constrained pipeline (table-plane leveling, closed-form yaw/scale/translation, 12-seed yaw sweep), proving low RMSE alone cannot validate registration.

projects.title: Robotics Semantic Perception Pipeline
projects.role: TurtleBot3 to ROS2 to YOLOv8 to Zenoh to Postgres. Sensor to database, end to end.
report: Built an end-to-end sensor-to-database pipeline (TurtleBot3/Gazebo → ROS2 → YOLOv8 → Zenoh → PostgreSQL) ingesting 500+ detection events.
Extended it with 512-dim embeddings in pgvector and a semantic graph enabling object re-localization.

projects.title: Temporal Cycle-Consistency Self-Supervised Video Learning
projects.role: Temporal cycle-consistency from scratch. Literally learns to read the timing.
report: Implemented TCC loss and temporal segmentation from scratch.
Swept embedding dimensions D = {32, 64, 128}, with D = 128 achieving the best alignment (0.589).
Analyzed embeddings via PCA, UMAP and t-SNE visualizations.

projects.title: Faster R-CNN Hyperparameter Optimization
projects.role: Saved 22 minutes per trial. Best save of the season.
report: Built a 4-stage Optuna HPO pipeline (training, RPN anchors, RoI sampling, inference) on COCO-2017.
Cut per-trial runtime from 30 min to 8 min via deferred evaluation.
Improved tuned mAP 5% over baseline on VisDrone, with a custom VOC-to-COCO converter.
